_comment: PRIAM metadata for SportTracker. Load into PRIAM Data & Processing service via POST /api/data and POST /api/processing/create.

dataAttributes.sourceDetails: workout table, column name — user-assigned label for each activity

purposes.purposeDescription: Record, store and display the user's sport activities (name, date, duration, distance).

processings.consequence: Refusing consent disables heart-rate recording. All other workout tracking remains fully functional.

purposes.purposeDescription: Record and store per-workout heart-rate measurements (biometric data, GDPR Art. 9) to compute average BPM and display heart-rate charts.

processings.consequence: Refusing consent disables association of training partners with workouts.

purposes.purposeDescription: Associate named training partners with workout sessions for social tracking purposes.
